posts.text: Pam Bondi is out. It is being reported that President Trump has fired Pam Bondi, who has been the Attorney General of the United States since the beginning of the Trump administration.

President Trump’s speech on the Iran conflict did not provide a lot of details.  What are the key takeaways from the presidential prime time speech?  The president spent a lot of time talking about himself and other issues, including Venezuela, but provide provided very little detail about issues that are important to the American public, including whether or not boots on the grounds are in the plans and even what victory looks like.

Pete Hegseth, the U.S. secretary of defense, is demanding other countries “step up” to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz, because other countries use it and need it more than the United States. The Strait of Hormuz is used to deliver almost a quarter of the world’s oil, and has been closed to traffic since the end of February, when the United States attacked Iran.

After allegations of surfaced that Kristi Noem’s husband, Byron Noem, is leading a happy life she didn’t know about, the former secretary of the Department of homeland security is asking for prayers and privacy.  What happened when Kristi denied so many their own privacy?

During the recent CPAC conservative, Conference, RFK Junior said that he thinks Donald Trump has an “encyclopedic, molecular knowledge“. He also recounted a story where apparently Trump drew a perfect map of the Middle East with borders and troop sizes for each country.  evidence suggests otherwise, regarding Trump‘s IQ.

President Trump has signed an executive order that directs federal agencies to develop a federal registry of citizens allowed to vote and limits the ability for the United States Postal Service to send requested mail in ballot.

Judge has ordered the Trump administration to immediately stop all work on the $400 million White House ballroom. The order is a temporary injunction until litigation is completed regarding claims that President Trump exceeded his authority in ordering the construction, and that the procedures bypassed congressional authorization and environmental laws.

A federal court just ruled that the executive order that ended all federal funding for PBS and NPR is unlawful and invalid, and decided that it was issued in retaliation of the TV stations’ viewpoint, therefore violating the stations’ First Amendment rights.  #npr #firstamendment #executiveorder #lawyersoftiktok

The Israeli parliament Knesset passed a law whose effect is to mandate Israeli military courts in the West Bank to apply punishment against Palestinians for specific crimes that aren’t applied against Israeli citizens.  The law also allows civilian courts within Israel to choose those punishments if the crime is characterized by “nationalistic” motives, potentially creating the same two-tier system between Israelis and Palestinians.
